parrafo_1.es: Essential Roofing Corp es un negocio local que atiende Westchester, Miami y zonas cercanas. El que responde el mensaje es el mismo equipo que llega a hacer el trabajo: sin centrales telefónicas ni intermediarios.
parrafo_1.en: Essential Roofing Corp is a local business serving Westchester, Miami and nearby areas. Whoever answers your message is the same crew that shows up to do the work: no call centers, no middlemen.

parrafo_2.es: Una clienta reciente, Marjorie Beasley, lo resumió así en Google: después de pedir ocho presupuestos de techos, Essential Roofing Corp quedó justo en el rango que esperaba para un techo nuevo, sofitos, fascia y canaletas, y Todd hizo que todo el proceso fuera sencillo y profesional.
parrafo_2.en: A recent client, Marjorie Beasley, put it well on Google: after getting eight roofing estimates, Essential Roofing Corp came in right around what she expected for a new roof, soffits, fascia and gutters, and Todd made the whole process easy and professional.

items.quote: We got 8 roofing estimates, and the pricing was all over the board, but Essential Roofing Corp. came in right around what we expected for a new roof, soffits, fascia, and gutters. Todd made the whole process easy.

I'm very impressed with Evan and Jay. They really went the extra mile to make the damaged roof repair feel easy and stress free. Jay took care of the paperwork, and Evan kept me updated through each step of the roofing process.
Huge shout out to company: Essential Roofing Corp. They put a roof over my deck and later installed new gutters on my home, and both jobs turned out excellent.
